titleEn: Ebda Store assistant: ask how to do it
steps: Open the assistant panel in the admin (button or Ctrl/Cmd+J) and ask how to do something
It answers from the help guides and from your own data it may read; it links the screen with "show me where"
Off by default per store; a super admin turns it on (answer-only, then suggest, then act) and can switch it off at once
It never asks for a password, key or code: it links the secure screen
edgeCases: Mode off or AI switched off for the store: the panel is hidden and the route answers status off
Over 150 turns per store per day: the reply says the limit was reached
A team member without the permission gets no answer about that area, only where the owner can do it
The store is not on its Durable Object yet: the route answers 503, never a fallback

readOnlyPost.reason: The turn route only answers and prepares preview cards; nothing in the store changes from it. The only thing written is the assistant's own masked journal rows. Changes are applied by the separate ai.assistant-actions routes.
